description.value:
You hurl a small explosive charge to a point you can see within range. It remains in place until the start of your next turn, when it detonates and the power ends; you may also use your reaction beforehand to trigger it early. When it explodes, each creature within 5 feet of the point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage and 1d8 kinetic damage, taking half as much on a success.

Cast with a 2nd-level slot or higher, you can hurl one additional charge, all detonating together, for each slot level above 1st; a creature caught by more than one charge is affected only once.
